subject: Current-source collection and callable borrow composition with bounded fresh WV tests
claim: Thirty-four complete-module composition groups extend the existing typed-stack WV suite. They cover array projections and construction, nested record/Sequence observations, borrowed scalar Vector inputs, owned-aggregate loan creation and non-escape, inherited owned-Option views, and exact callable payloads/results/indirect calls. The mixed type-category scan advances once per descriptor and retains callable identities. A seeded omission of a retained Sequence receiver read is caught at group 183. After byte-exact restoration, all 150 focused groups pass with fresh native execution in a 2,396 ms cached run. Complete WVB 1.39 admission remains closed.

source.value: Worktree based on 6a4561b6edd149f02d1fde6fb69782f579eba630. Exact final production, test, and routing inputs are recorded below; unchanged bootstrap identities remain owned by that source state. The intentional Sequence-length receiver-read omission was restored byte for byte before the final run, which reused the passing cold run's exact project and native products.

runs.target: Intentional implementation defect: remove only the explicit retained-receiver read for opcode 203 (Sequence length). Other consumed-operand reads and opcode 204 remain unchanged. Composition group 183 catches a borrowed receiver left on the stack while its owner is overwritten: native exit 183, harness exit 1. Project construction 17,628 ms; verification and packaging 63,952 ms; both caches create new products. This expected failure is defect-detection evidence, not a passing verification receipt.

Existing focused fixture routing and full-source exclusions remain intact. Planning passes 31 general and 280 native cases, with 6 front-end reuse products and 63 subsets. The registry retains 126 owners and declares 6,193 cases; the full memory-budget owner declares 384, combined Foundation selector 213, and focused owner selector 150. No owner or entry point was added. Node.js syntax and git whitespace checks pass.

Read-only plan review. The final implementation/specification change set selects 12 owners, expected 2,925 seconds and maximum 11,700 seconds, without gaps. That broad plan was not executed. The exact changed stack fixture selects the existing focused --foundation-borrow-owners mode, expected 180 seconds and maximum 600 seconds.

Documentation validation passes: 1,587 Markdown files, 5,709 links, 462 anchors, 10 active-context documents, and 12 documented legacy decision collisions. Catalogs are current and all 14 retrieval cases pass.

limitations: These are current-source component checks, not complete WVB 1.39 admission, execution of candidate modules, compiler publication of every constructed combination, or product qualification. The explicit complete-admission guard is unchanged.

Remaining operand families (including nominal-enum observations and record-construction read-through), owned Vector payload projection, wider ownership/capability interactions, inherited Foreign typing, and source value-classification reconciliation still require implementation and evidence. The admitted callable cell remains restricted to existing function-reference/plain-capture contracts; no new capture class or descriptor mode is admitted.

The first development run failed at positive mixed-directory group 166. Inspection found double index advancement in the type-category scan for collections; the corrected scan passes all 150 groups. An intermediate diagnostic used an out-of-range process result and reported exit 1. First-composition phase failures now use bounded exit codes 231 through 237. Neither failed run is claimed as passing evidence.

New execution is local Windows only. Preceding commit 6a4561b6 passed GitHub run 33942796515; that run is not evidence for these new bytes. Linux reproduction and exact paired-host qualification remain pending.
Timings are single development observations with retained bootstrap products, not clean-machine measurements or stable speedup thresholds. Peak working-set memory was not measured.

The broad 12-owner plan, full 384-case owner, complete earlier-version regression gates, database/library integration, runtime, compiler reconstruction, bootstrap, ABI, and cross-host qualification were not run. The broad plan exceeds the ten-minute local development budget.

WV behavior tests still compile through the retained Seed/bootstrap project path. Edition-1 migration remains part of the active goal; host orchestration and independent oracles retain their separate roles.
